name: signal recognition particle 19
pathways: SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, signal sequence recognition

function.text: SRP19 encodes signal recognition particle 19 kDa protein. Annotated molecular activities include 7S RNA binding. It participates in cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, signal sequence recognition.
